record.title: DfCM current frontier
record.body: Frontier now contains R56 executable replication qualification and R56 combinatorial pair/triple measurement on marketplace default d1ed42b2. Newly reachable edges: target-local adapter manufacture for admitted but partial consumers; returned independent receipt assimilation; independence-weighted R54 qualification; pair/triple consumer compositions once exact consumer receipts exist; causal downstream yield measurement. Weakest multiplier remains independent qualified consumer breadth: 2 full-replication-ready of 10 target, shortfall 8. 1000X remains NOT_ADMITTED.
